title: Standup cadence for the platform cell
content: Standups moved to 09:30 UTC after the London hire; the Friday slot is written notes only, no call.

title: Staging database refresh procedure
content: Staging refreshes from the Sunday snapshot; never refresh mid-week because the analytics backfill reads staging directly.

title: Vendor invoice approval path
content: Invoices under 500 go straight to accounting; anything larger needs the cell lead's sign-off first, logged in the shared tracker.

title: Build cache flakiness on the arm runners
content: The arm64 CI runners occasionally serve a stale build cache; a re-run with CACHE_BUST=1 clears it. Filed upstream, no fix yet.

title: Docs style ruling
content: Docs speak present truth — no 'previously' framing, history lives in git. User-facing surfaces get one short sentence with no internals.
